requirement.description: The AXS class is missing the 'udot' attribute which is accessed in the test suite but not defined in the class constructor.
requirement.contract: The AXS class constructor should initialize all expected attributes including 'udot' to prevent AttributeError when accessing this attribute.

requirement.description: Configuration parsing fails due to incorrect handling of special characters and malformed lines in config files, particularly when processing lines with colon separators.
requirement.contract: The config parsing logic should correctly handle all valid configuration formats and provide proper error messages for invalid configurations.

requirement.description: Volume string parsing logic incorrectly handles comma-separated user identifiers and special characters in user names, causing assertion failures.
requirement.contract: The _read_vol_str method should properly parse user lists that may contain periods and other special characters, and correctly handle empty user specifications.

requirement.description: Directory listing logic does not properly respect the dotsrch flag when filtering dotfiles, leading to incorrect file visibility in test cases.
requirement.contract: The VFS.ls method should correctly apply dotsrch filtering to both real and virtual files, respecting the configured flag settings.

requirement.description: Directory traversal logic does not properly handle the dotsrch filtering for directories, leading to incorrect inclusion/exclusion of dotfiles in test scenarios.
requirement.contract: The VFS.walk method should consistently apply dotsrch filtering to both files and directories when the flag is disabled.
